audit.whatIsWrong: Early phase described his damage as 'shotgun legs auto-shred' with no mechanism you can avoid.
audit.why: Purge prioritises enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities — so a landed Corrosive Charge is what commits the legs onto you. That makes dodging the Q, not backing out of auto range, the actual early counterplay.
audit.corrected: Level 1-3 spike and early text now state the Q-into-Purge priority link.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] gave Disdain a '~14s cooldown' and every other stage gave none.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — 14s is the rank-5 value, and in lane you are almost always playing against the rank-1 or rank-2 number. Being told to commit two seconds early is how you get flipped.
audit.corrected: All Disdain references now use 16s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain was called 'that single point-and-click' and 'a point-and-click flip-into-fear chain', and its shield was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: Urgot charges in a direction and only stops if he catches a champion — it is a directional charge, not a targeted cast, and it shields him on the way in. That shield is exactly what eats the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: Every point-and-click reference replaced with the directional charge, and the self-shield added so you know to force it out before committing.

edits.before: His Corrosive Charge (Q) out-ranges your Five Point Strike, and the second you step up to last-hit his shotgun legs auto-shred you while you have no Shroud to reset — concede the chip war.
edits.after: His Corrosive Charge (Q) out-ranges Five Point Strike, and Purge (W) prioritises whoever he just hit with it — so a landed Q is what commits the legs onto you. Concede the chip war until Shroud.

edits.before: Your one clean window: bait his Disdain (E flip), then E-mark, dash, and use Perfect Execution's second cast to finish him while his flip is on cooldown and he's still squishy.
edits.after: Your one clean window: bait Disdain (E), a directional charge that shields him, then E-mark, dash, and land Perfect Execution's second cast while that 16s flip is down.

edits.before: Lich Bane gives you the burst to all-in, but a single Disdain flip cancels your combo, his W legs grind your HP, and once you're low his R drill executes and fears you for the kill.
edits.after: Lich Bane gives you the burst to all-in, but one Disdain cancels your combo and shields him, Purge grinds your HP, and once you are low his R impales and executes you.

edits.before: Bait his Disdain (E flip), then E-mark, dash in, and finish with Perfect Execution's recast while his flip is on its ~14s cooldown
edits.after: Bait his Disdain (E charge), then E-mark, dash in, and finish with Perfect Execution's recast while the flip is on its 16s cooldown

edits.before: Hold Twilight Shroud for his flip so the untargetable window dodges the E and breaks his shotgun-leg DPS, then re-engage on your terms
edits.after: Hold Twilight Shroud for his commit — unselectable, Purge cannot lock onto you, so the leg DPS stops and you re-engage on your terms

edits.before: Land Disdain (E flip) to drag you out of position, then auto with his shotgun legs to shred you before you can drop Shroud
edits.after: Charge Disdain through you to hurl you out of position behind a shield, then Purge your HP down before you can drop Shroud

edits.before: Urgot owns levels 1-3 here. His Corrosive Charge (Q) out-ranges your Five Point Strike, and the moment you step up to last-hit his shotgun legs auto-shred you while you have no Shroud yet to reset the trade. Farm with the tip of your kunai, eat a little Q poke, and do NOT walk into auto range of his legs — every chunk of HP he shaves is burst you needed for level 6. Track his Disdain (E flip); that single point-and-click is what drags you in and kills you in this lane.
edits.after: Urgot owns levels 1-3 here. His Corrosive Charge (Q) out-ranges your Five Point Strike, and Purge prioritises the champion he most recently hit with an ability — so the Q landing is what turns the legs on. Farm with the tip of your kunai, dodge the charge, and do NOT stand in Purge range while you have no Shroud to reset. Every chunk of HP he shaves is burst you needed for level 6. Track Disdain (E), 16s at rank 1: that directional charge shields him and hurls you, and it is what kills you in this lane.

edits.before: Once you have Twilight Shroud at 4-5 you can finally fight, but only on his Disdain cooldown — bait the flip, drop smoke to go untargetable through his legs, then E-mark and Q-sweetspot. Six is your real window: E-dash plus Perfect Execution's recast finishes him IF his flip is down and he hasn't built armor. If Disdain is up, give it up — one flip into shotgun-leg autos and his R fear ends you. This is the only stage you genuinely own, so make it count.
edits.after: Once you have Twilight Shroud at 4-5 you can finally fight, but only on his Disdain cooldown — bait the charge, drop smoke so Purge cannot select you, then E-mark and Q-sweetspot. Six is your real window: E-dash plus Perfect Execution's recast finishes him IF that 16s flip is down and he hasn't built armour. If Disdain is up, give it up — one charge, shielded, into Purge and his R ends you. This is the only stage you genuinely own, so make it count.

edits.before: This is where you lose. You cannot one-shot a tanky armor-stacked Urgot — his shotgun-leg DPS out-trades your burst and his Fear Beyond Death (R) executes you the second you drop under its missing-health threshold, fearing you so you can't Shroud out. Your smoke can't blank a point-and-click flip-into-fear chain. Convert your level 6 and Lich Bane lead into a closed-out game; if it goes long, stop forcing solo and play for picks with your team instead of feeding his R.
edits.after: This is where you lose. You cannot one-shot a tanky armour-stacked Urgot — Purge out-trades your burst and Fear Beyond Death (R) impales you the second you drop under its missing-health threshold, and at 100s on rank 1 it is up for most of your windows. Your smoke does nothing about a directional charge, only about what has to select you. Convert your level 6 and Lich Bane lead into a closed-out game; if it goes long, stop forcing solo and play for picks with your team.

edits.before: Full kit online with Shroud, but his Disdain flip and ranged Q poke keep it a genuine coin-flip on who commits.
edits.after: Full kit online with Shroud, but his 16s Disdain charge and ranged Q poke keep it a genuine coin-flip on who commits.

edits.before: He trades around Disdain's cooldown and his sustained shotgun-leg DPS out-banks your spiky energy-gated chip.
edits.after: He trades around Disdain's 16s charge and his Purge DPS out-banks your spiky energy-gated chip damage.

edits.before: Lich Bane gives you the burst to all-in, but one flip into his legs and his R fear cancels your combo, so it stays even.
edits.after: Lich Bane gives you the burst to all-in, but one shielded charge into Purge and his R cancels your combo, so it stays even.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain, 16s at rank 1: matchup-defining — a directional charge that shields him and hurls you. - Purge locks the champion his Q just hit. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A directional charge, 16s at rank 1, and it shields him. Bait it.

notes: Two claims removed rather than repeated: Disdain is not point-and-click (Riot: 'charges in a direction... if he catches an enemy champion he will stop and hurl them'), and Riot's Fear Beyond Death text describes an impale and an execute on the target, with no fear applied to the impaled champion — the old late text said the R 'fears you so you can't Shroud out'. I did not assert the opposite; I rewrote around it and am recording the fear-on-target question as unverified.
